test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Eight friends are sitting around a square table facing the centre. Four of them are sitting at the corners and remaining four are sitting at the exact middle of the four sides. Aman is sitting fourth to the left of Priya. Lakshay is an immediate neighbour of both Priya and Sakshi. Utkarsh is sitting fourth to the left of Sakshi. Riddhi is sitting to the immediate right of Utkarsh. Priya is sitting to the immediate left of Vidhi. Vidhi is sitting fourth to the right of Tejaswi. Who is sitting to the immediate right of Aman?
solution:
Given: Eight friends are sitting around a square table facing the centre.

Four of them are sitting at the corners and remaining four are sitting at the exact middle of the four sides.

1) Aman is sitting fourth to the left of Priya.

2) Priya is sitting to the immediate left of Vidhi.

3) Vidhi is sitting fourth to the right of Tejaswi.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b1546a78c9b8aa2fd4e538956904cfc03f32642f94567430e24095310631cd61.png] 

4) Lakshay is an immediate neighbour of both Priya and Sakshi.

5) Utkarsh is sitting fourth to the left of Sakshi.

6) Riddhi is sitting to the immediate right of Utkarsh. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/be563e2f3a65d9a6d5b8004aef7578dd932b44f57e2a09a7755dbb4d200dc5b2.png] 

Here, 'Twjaswi' is sitting to the immediate right of Aman.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**.
